title: Pitfalls in the Evaluation of Sentence Embeddings
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical evaluation of sentence embeddings, identifying and discussing pitfalls related to methodology (e.g., embedding size, normalization, choice of classifiers, correlation metrics).
